name: Opus
description: Workspaces, kanban, tasks, comments and time entries in one place. Fast, opinionated project tracking — everything you need, nothing you don't.

name: Sablier
description: Live timers you start and stop in one click, scoped to spaces, projects and tasks. Billing rates, reminders, and two-way sync with Opus over the Antenne.

name: Ardoise
description: Quotes, invoices and contracts typeset properly, paid through Stripe or plain bank transfer. Your clients get a portal, you get a notification — that is the whole ceremony.

name: Plume
description: Drop a PDF, place the fields for each signer, send the link. You get back a flattened document, a signature certificate, an audit trail and a public way to verify it.

name: Agenda
tagline: One calendar the whole studio reads.
description: Personal and shared calendars with real roles, and real CalDAV underneath. Apple Calendar, Thunderbird and your phone sync with it natively — no Google in the middle.

name: Courrier
description: Connect the IMAP and SMTP accounts you already have, in one clean interface. Threading that survives out-of-order delivery, full-text search, templates and bulk actions.

name: Nuage
description: Files in spaces, versioned on every reupload, with a trash that forgives you. Resumable uploads, WebDAV mounting, quotas — and your files stay on your server.

name: Capsule
description: Encrypted in the browser, with the key living in the URL fragment so the server only ever holds ciphertext. One link, one opening, then nothing.

name: Casier
tagline: Every secret, none of them on disk.
description: Projects, environments and versioned secrets sealed under per-project keys wrapped by a root key that is never written down. The CLI injects them straight into a process — nothing lands in a dotfile.

name: Vision
description: A 3.7 KB script, zero cookies, no IP stored, and a dashboard that streams live. You learn where your traffic comes from without selling your users' souls.

name: Journal
description: Apps ship structured entries over HTTP and search them full-text with saved queries and level histograms. A saved query crossing its threshold becomes an alert.

name: Antenne
tagline: The nervous system of the suite.
description: Alert aggregation and the suite's event bus. It watches providers, routes what they emit to Matrix, Discord, mail or push, and hosts the durable pool every other app syncs through.

name: Perception
description: Perception listens to the whole event stream and turns it into durable business memory. Clients, contracts, projects, hours — ask in plain language, get a sourced answer.

name: Echo
tagline: A room, a link, that is it.
description: Video conferencing reduced to what a meeting needs. Transcription runs on our own machines, so the audio of your calls never reaches a vendor.

name: Scribe
description: A desktop app that captures system audio and transcribes it locally, in twenty-five languages, without the recording ever touching the disk. You get the transcript live, and structured notes after.

name: Galet
description: Markdown on disk, backlinks, graph and canvas on top of it, in the browser, on the desktop and on Android. Sync is end-to-end encrypted through a relay that can read none of it.

name: Toile
tagline: An infinite wall of sticky notes.
description: Every note is one markdown file with its position in the frontmatter, so a Toile board is just a folder. Point it at a vault you already have and it opens on your phone.

name: Glouton
description: Glouton crawls the web while you sleep, reads the stack a site is built on, and scores what it finds. You wake up to the good leads, ranked.

name: Spore
description: Declare a monorepo in YAML, link local packages, pull published ones from the registry, run the scripts you named. It does not care which language they are written in.

name: Jardin
tagline: The shared brain of our agents.
description: One canonical store of agent memory, rules and skills, written in plain markdown and fanned out into every assistant's native config. Every machine, every agent, the same ground truth.

name: Atelier
tagline: A team of agents on one goal.
description: A durable orchestrator that decomposes a goal into a task graph, sets builders to work on their own branches, and lets reviewers gate the merges. It coordinates with Jardin for memory and claims.

name: Portail
tagline: One door to all the others.
description: The home page of the studio: every internal service in one list, with type-ahead and a command palette. One self-contained page, no framework, no build step.
